note: Smart IP data source that geolocates offline against an IP2Location BIN database (via ip2location/ip2location-php). sourceId()='ip2location_bin_db'; configName()='smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings' with keys version(lite|licensed, default lite), edition(BIN code, default DB11), token, db_auto_update(default false), caching_method(no_cache|memory_cache|shared_memory, default no_cache), bin_file_custom_path. The actual IP lookup needs an external BIN file that is NOT present on this site, so medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in config the agent can set without the binary DB: the product edition and the reader caching_method. Shipped defaults used by reset/cleanup: edition=DB11, caching_method=no_cache.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Smart IP IP2Location binary database submodule. What value do I set for smart_ip.settings:data_source to actually make Smart IP use it, and where does this submodule store its own settings?
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip.settings:data_source to ip2location_bin_db (the source's sourceId()). Its own settings live in the smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings config object.

evals.prompt: For the Smart IP IP2Location binary database source, which config key selects the IP2Location product edition (BIN code), what is its default value, and which key chooses between the free LITE and the licensed database?
evals.expected_output: smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings:edition is the BIN product code (default DB11, e.g. DB1..DB24), and version chooses lite (free IP2Location LITE, the default) vs licensed.

evals.prompt: What external PHP library does the Smart IP IP2Location binary database source rely on to read the BIN file, and is the lookup done offline or via an API call?
evals.expected_output: It uses the ip2location/ip2location-php library (already required by the smart_ip project's composer.json) and performs the lookup fully offline against the local BIN file - no per-request API call.

evals.prompt: On this live site the Smart IP IP2Location binary database source is configured with a specific IP2Location product edition. Inspect the running configuration and give the edition (BIN code) it is set to.
evals.expected_output: smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings:edition is DB3 (read with `drush cget smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings edition`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Smart IP IP2Location binary database source so its reader uses the 'Shared memory' caching method (the fastest option) instead of no cache. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings:caching_method to shared_memory (valid values: no_cache, memory_cache, shared_memory), e.g. `drush cset smart_ip_ip2location_bin_db.settings caching_method shared_memory -y`.
